answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The cedar edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 36 clones produces a signature the ridge analysis flags immediately. An attacker must as a result build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the anchor settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 27 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
